def local_time(value):
    require(isinstance(value, str) and LOCAL.fullmatch(value), "timephased_local_time",
            "Use an explicit project-local date and time with T and no timezone conversion.", value)
    try:
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise ValueError("The selected project-local period boundary is not a valid calendar value.") from error
    require(parsed.tzinfo is None, "timephased_timezone", "Keep the native project's local time.")
    return parsed.isoformat(timespec="microseconds" if parsed.microsecond else "seconds")


def normalize_profile(value, coverage):
    if value is None:
        return None
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) <= {"schema", "periods", "series"},
            "timephased_profile", "Select the original native reporting ranges and assignment series.")
    require(value.get("schema", PROFILE_SCHEMA) == PROFILE_SCHEMA, "timephased_profile_schema",
            "Use the original timephased reporting profile.")
    periods = value.get("periods")
    require(isinstance(periods, list) and 1 <= len(periods) <= MAX_PERIODS,
            "timephased_period_count", "Select 1 to 3,660 exact reporting periods.")
    normalized, keys, previous_finish = [], set(), None
    for ordinal, item in enumerate(periods):
        require(isinstance(item, dict) and set(item) == {"key", "label", "start", "finish"},
                "timephased_period", "Retain each period key, label and the exact native local start/finish bounds.")
        key, label = item["key"], item["label"]
        require(isinstance(key, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}", key)
                and key not in keys and isinstance(label, str) and 0 < len(label) <= 240,
                "timephased_period_identity", "Give every period a unique key and readable label.")
        start, finish = local_time(item["start"]), local_time(item["finish"])
        require(datetime.fromisoformat(start) < datetime.fromisoformat(finish)
                and (previous_finish is None or datetime.fromisoformat(start) >= datetime.fromisoformat(previous_finish)),
                "timephased_period_overlap", "Keep the selected periods ordered, nonempty and nonoverlapping.")
        normalized.append({"key": key, "label": label, "start": start, "finish": finish})
        keys.add(key)
        previous_finish = finish
    definitions = {item["field"]: item for item in coverage["assignments"]}
    selected, names = value.get("series"), set()
    require(isinstance(selected, list) and 1 <= len(selected) <= 32,
            "timephased_series_count", "Choose 1 to 32 named native assignment series.")
    result = []
    for item in selected:
        require(isinstance(item, dict) and set(item) <= {"name", "field", "kind", "units"}
                and all(key in item for key in ("name", "field", "kind")),
                "timephased_series", "Keep the native series name, field, kind and work unit.")
        name, field, kind = item["name"], item["field"], item["kind"]
        require(isinstance(name, str) and NAME.fullmatch(name) and name not in names
                and kind in FIELDS and field in FIELDS[kind] and field in definitions,
                "timephased_native_field", "Choose a distinct series and a supported native assignment field.", item)
        types = {entry.get("data_type") for entry in definitions[field]["definitions"].values()}
        require(types and None not in types and types <= NATIVE_TYPES[kind],
                "timephased_native_type", "The chosen field's original native definitions do not match this series kind.",
                {"field": field, "kind": kind, "definitions": definitions[field]["definitions"]})
        units = item.get("units")
        require(units in UNITS if kind == "work" else units is None,
                "timephased_units", "Choose an explicit native work unit; currency and material retain their own units.")
        result.append({"name": name, "field": field, "kind": kind, **({"units": units} if kind == "work" else {})})
        names.add(name)
    return {"schema": PROFILE_SCHEMA, "periods": normalized, "series": result}


def profile_sha(profile):
    return digest(profile)


def source_binding(edition, profile):
    return {"edition_id": edition["id"], "model_sha256": edition["sha256"],
            "source_ids": edition["source_ids"], "recipe_sha256": digest(edition["recipe"]),
            "profile_sha256": profile_sha(profile)}


def period_identity(edition_id, profile, key):
    return digest({"edition_id": edition_id, "profile_sha256": profile_sha(profile), "period": key})


def series_identity(edition_id, profile, name):
    return digest({"edition_id": edition_id, "profile_sha256": profile_sha(profile), "series": name})


def method(series):
    return "ResourceAssignment.getTimephasedDurationValues" if series["kind"] == "work" else "ResourceAssignment.getTimephasedNumericValues"


def applicable(kind, resource_type):
    if kind == "work" and resource_type in {"MATERIAL", "COST"}:
        return False
    if kind == "material" and resource_type != "MATERIAL":
        return False
    return True


def series_semantics(series):
    return {
        "calendar_basis": "project_baseline_calendar" if series["field"].startswith("BASELINE") else "assignment_effective_calendar",
        "boundary_semantics": RANGE_SEMANTICS if series["kind"] == "money" else "project-local native duration/material overlap; finish excluded from duration overlap",
    }

"""Retain the actual MPXJ assignment-period calculation on its original edition."""
from __future__ import annotations

from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime
import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import uuid

from portfolio.native import make_keys, native_uid
from portfolio.storage import canonical, digest, now, require
from .timephased_contract import (CAPTURE_SCHEMA, MAX_CAPTURE_BYTES, MAX_FACTS, MAX_LINE_BYTES, MAX_ACCRUAL_STEPS,
    applicable, series_semantics, source_binding)


def _rows(objects, model_rows, family):
    objects = list(objects)
    retained = [{"uid": native_uid(item.getUniqueID())} for item in objects]
    make_keys(retained, family, [])
    require(len(retained) == len(model_rows)
            and all(a["key"] == b["key"] and a["uid"] == b["uid"] and a["ordinal"] == b["ordinal"]
                    for a, b in zip(retained, model_rows)),
            "timephased_native_rows", "The reopened native row identities differ from the selected original edition.", family)
    index = defaultdict(list)
    for item, row in zip(objects, model_rows):
        index[row["uid"]].append((item, row))
    return objects, index


def _join(item, index):
    if item is None:
        return None, "not_set"
    matches = [row for native, row in index.get(native_uid(item.getUniqueID()), []) if native == item]
    require(len(matches) <= 1, "timephased_native_alias",
            "An actual native object matches multiple retained row identities.")
    return (matches[0], "native_object") if matches else (None, "derived_native_object")


def _definition(field):
    return {"name": str(field.getName()), "data_type": str(field.getDataType().name()),
            "native_type": str(field.getDataType().getValue()),
            "units_field": None if field.getUnitsType() is None else str(field.getUnitsType().name()),
            "user_defined": False}


def _native_range_admission(assignments, model_rows, profile):
    """Guard the pinned COST-resource pro-rata loop before entering JNI."""
    selected = {row["field"] for row in profile["series"]}
    calls = sum(1 for row in profile["series"] if row["field"] in {"COST", "ACTUAL_COST", "ACTUAL_REGULAR_COST"})
    if not calls:
        return {}, {"schema": "portfolio.native-period-admission.v1", "prorata_cost_assignments": 0,
                    "estimated_native_steps": 0, "per_assignment_step_limit": MAX_ACCRUAL_STEPS}
    periods = [(datetime.fromisoformat(row["start"]), datetime.fromisoformat(row["finish"]))
               for row in profile["periods"]]
    def micros(delta):
        return (delta.days * 86400 + delta.seconds) * 1_000_000 + delta.microseconds
    width = micros(periods[0][1] - periods[0][0])
    fixed = width >= 60_000_000 and width % 60_000_000 == 0
    fixed = fixed and all(micros(b - a) == width for a, b in periods)
    fixed = fixed and all(a == periods[i - 1][1] for i, (a, b) in enumerate(periods) if i)
    result, total = {}, 0
    for assignment, row in zip(assignments, model_rows):
        resource = assignment.getResource()
        if resource is None or resource.getType() is None or str(resource.getType().name()) != "COST":
            continue
        accrue = resource.getAccrueAt()
        if accrue is not None and str(accrue.name()) in {"START", "END"}:
            continue
        actual = assignment.getActualCost()
        if actual is None or actual.doubleValue() == 0.0:
            continue
        start, finish = assignment.getStart(), assignment.getFinish()
        require(start is not None and finish is not None, "timephased_native_cost_bounds",
                "This actual pro-rata COST resource needs its original native assignment bounds.", row["key"])
        start, finish = datetime.fromisoformat(str(start)), datetime.fromisoformat(str(finish))
        require(start <= finish, "timephased_native_cost_bounds",
                "The native pro-rata COST resource has reversed assignment bounds.", row["key"])
        if periods[-1][1] <= start or periods[0][0] >= finish:
            continue
        require(fixed, "timephased_native_cost_grid",
                "The pinned native pro-rata actual-cost method requires contiguous, equal-width ranges with a positive whole-minute stride. Choose a fixed daily/weekly grid for this COST resource.",
                {"assignment": row["key"], "fields": sorted(selected & {"COST", "ACTUAL_COST", "ACTUAL_REGULAR_COST"})})
        # The original method walks from the first selected boundary to the
        # assignment, then allocates ranges for its complete start/finish span.
        estimate = abs(micros(start - periods[0][0])) // width + micros(finish - start) // width + 5
        total += estimate * calls
        require(estimate <= MAX_ACCRUAL_STEPS and total <= MAX_FACTS, "timephased_native_cost_extent",
                "This exact native pro-rata cost grid would allocate too many internal ranges. Select a wider fixed reporting interval near the original assignment.",
                {"assignment": row["key"], "estimated_steps": estimate, "total_steps": total,
                 "per_assignment_limit": MAX_ACCRUAL_STEPS, "total_limit": MAX_FACTS})
        result[row["key"]] = {"native_method": "ResourceAssignment.getTimephasedActualCostProrata",
                              "resource_accrue_at": "PRORATED" if accrue is None else str(accrue.name()),
                              "minutes_per_range": width // 60_000_000,
                              "estimated_native_steps": estimate,
                              "assignment_start": start.isoformat(), "assignment_finish": finish.isoformat()}
    return result, {"schema": "portfolio.native-period-admission.v1",
                    "prorata_cost_assignments": len(result), "estimated_native_steps": total,
                    "per_assignment_step_limit": MAX_ACCRUAL_STEPS}


def capture(portfolio, operator_store, edition, profile, destination, *, stopped=None):
    """One read-only native calculation; publish complete immutable bytes only."""
    assignment_count = len(edition["model"]["assignments"])
    fact_count = assignment_count * len(profile["series"]) * len(profile["periods"])
    require(fact_count <= MAX_FACTS, "timephased_fact_limit",
            "This exact calculation exceeds two million assignment-period facts; narrow its periods or series before review.",
            {"facts": fact_count, "assignments": assignment_count, "periods": len(profile["periods"]),
             "series": len(profile["series"])})
    path = Path(destination)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    temporary = path.parent / ("." + path.name + "." + uuid.uuid4().hex + ".incoming")
    written, lines = 0, 0
    content_hash = hashlib.sha256()

    def check():
        require(stopped is None or not stopped(), "timephased_interrupted",
                "Reopen the same saved reporting request to continue its original read-only calculation.")

    try:
        with portfolio.native_project(edition["id"]) as project:
            native, model = portfolio.native, edition["model"]
            runtime = native.ensure()
            require(runtime["version"] == model["native"]["version"]
                    and runtime["upstream_commit"] == model["native"]["upstream_commit"],
                    "timephased_native_version", "Calculate this source with its original pinned native library.")
            assignments, _ = _rows(project.getResourceAssignments(), model["assignments"], "assignments")
            _, resources = _rows(project.getResources(), model["resources"], "resources")
            _, tasks = _rows(project.getTasks(), model["tasks"], "tasks")
            _, calendars = _rows(project.getCalendars(), model["calendars"], "calendars")
            enum = native.jclass("org.mpxj.AssignmentField")
            TimeUnit = native.jclass("org.mpxj.TimeUnit")
            DateTime = native.jclass("java.time.LocalDateTime")
            Range = native.jclass("org.mpxj.LocalDateTimeRange")
            ranges = native.jclass("java.util.ArrayList")()
            for period in profile["periods"]:
                ranges.add(Range(DateTime.parse(period["start"]), DateTime.parse(period["finish"])))
            selected_fields = {}
            catalogue = model["field_catalogue"].get("assignments", {})
            for series in profile["series"]:
                field = enum.valueOf(series["field"])
                require(assignment_count == 0 or _definition(field) == catalogue.get(series["field"]), "timephased_field_definition",
                        "The selected field's actual native definition differs from its saved source.", series["field"])
                selected_fields[series["name"]] = field
            range_admission, input_admission = _native_range_admission(assignments, model["assignments"], profile)
            baseline = project.getBaselineCalendar() if any(row["field"].startswith("BASELINE") for row in profile["series"]) else None
            baseline_row, baseline_resolution = _join(baseline, calendars)
            baseline_findings = []
            baseline_value = None if baseline is None else {
                "uid": native_uid(baseline.getUniqueID()),
                "name": None if baseline.getName() is None else str(baseline.getName()),
                "definition": native._calendar_details(baseline, baseline_findings, "project_baseline_calendar")}
            baseline_basis = {"key": None if baseline_row is None else baseline_row["key"],
                              "resolution": baseline_resolution, "value": baseline_value,
                              "findings": baseline_findings}
            binding = source_binding(edition, profile)
            capture_id = digest({"schema": CAPTURE_SCHEMA, "binding": binding, "native": runtime})
            header = {"record": "header", "schema": CAPTURE_SCHEMA, "capture_id": capture_id,
                      "binding": binding, "profile": profile, "native": runtime, "captured_at": now(),
                      "assignment_count": assignment_count, "fact_count": fact_count,
                      "field_definitions": {row["field"]: catalogue.get(row["field"]) for row in profile["series"]},
                      "series_semantics": {row["name"]: series_semantics(row) for row in profile["series"]},
                      "baseline_calendar": baseline_basis, "input_admission": input_admission}
            resource_rates = {}
            raw_fields = {name: enum.valueOf(name) for name in sorted(catalogue) if name.startswith("RAW_TIMEPHASED_")}
            with open(temporary, "xb") as stream:
                os.chmod(temporary, 0o600)

                def write(value):
                    nonlocal written, lines
                    raw = canonical(value) + b"\n"
                    require(len(raw) <= MAX_LINE_BYTES and written + len(raw) <= MAX_CAPTURE_BYTES,
                            "timephased_capture_size", "The complete native calculation exceeds its retained-record limit.")
                    stream.write(raw)
                    content_hash.update(raw)
                    written += len(raw)
                    lines += 1

                write(header)
                native_errors = 0
                for ordinal, (assignment, row) in enumerate(zip(assignments, model["assignments"])):
                    check()
                    require(native_uid(assignment.getTaskUniqueID()) == row.get("task_uid")
                            and native_uid(assignment.getResourceUniqueID()) == row.get("resource_uid"),
                            "timephased_assignment_links", "The original assignment's native task or resource changed.", row["key"])
                    resource, task = assignment.getResource(), assignment.getTask()
                    resource_row, resource_resolution = _join(resource, resources)
                    task_row, task_resolution = _join(task, tasks)
                    require(resource is None or resource_row is not None, "timephased_resource_identity",
                            "The native assignment's resource is outside its retained project.", row["key"])
                    require(task is None or task_row is not None, "timephased_task_identity",
                            "The native assignment's task is outside its retained project.", row["key"])
                    current_findings = []
                    # Read the exact native raw inputs before the period getters. The
                    # saved edition was captured through these same native methods.
                    for field_name, field in raw_fields.items():
                        current = native._encode(assignment.get(field), current_findings,
                                                  "assignments/" + row["key"] + "/fields/" + field_name)
                        require(current == row["fields"].get(field_name), "timephased_raw_preimage",
                                "The native raw spans differ from the selected original source.", {"assignment": row["key"], "field": field_name})
                    resource_type = None if resource is None or resource.getType() is None else str(resource.getType().name())
                    material_label = None if resource is None or resource.getMaterialLabel() is None else str(resource.getMaterialLabel())
                    if resource_row is not None and resource_row["key"] not in resource_rates:
                        current = native._resource_details(resource, current_findings, "resources/" + resource_row["key"])
                        require(current == resource_row.get("native_details"), "timephased_rates_preimage",
                                "The native resource rate or availability definitions differ from the saved source.", resource_row["key"])
                        resource_rates[resource_row["key"]] = digest(current)
                    effective = assignment.getEffectiveCalendar()
                    calendar_row, calendar_resolution = _join(effective, calendars)
                    effective_value = None if effective is None else {
                        "uid": native_uid(effective.getUniqueID()),
                        "name": None if effective.getName() is None else str(effective.getName()),
                        "definition": native._calendar_details(effective, current_findings, "effective_calendar/" + row["key"])}
                    basis = {"record": "assignment_basis", "ordinal": ordinal, "assignment_key": row["key"],
                             "assignment_uid": row["uid"], "task_key": None if task_row is None else task_row["key"],
                             "task_resolution": task_resolution,
                             "resource_key": None if resource_row is None else resource_row["key"],
                             "resource_resolution": resource_resolution, "resource_type": resource_type,
                             "material_label": material_label,
                             "calendar_key": None if calendar_row is None else calendar_row["key"],
                             "calendar_resolution": calendar_resolution, "effective_calendar": effective_value,
                             "cost_rate_table": native._encode(assignment.get(enum.COST_RATE_TABLE), current_findings,
                                                               "assignments/" + row["key"] + "/fields/COST_RATE_TABLE"),
                             "resource_rates_sha256": None if resource_row is None else resource_rates[resource_row["key"]],
                             "native_range_admission": range_admission.get(row["key"]),
                             "findings": current_findings}
                    write(basis)
                    for series in profile["series"]:
                        check()
                        value = {"record": "series", "assignment_key": row["key"], "series": series["name"],
                                 "state": "native", "values": None, "error": None}
                        if not applicable(series["kind"], resource_type):
                            value["state"] = "not_applicable"
                        else:
                            try:
                                field = selected_fields[series["name"]]
                                output = (assignment.getTimephasedDurationValues(field, ranges, TimeUnit.valueOf(series["units"]))
                                          if series["kind"] == "work" else assignment.getTimephasedNumericValues(field, ranges))
                                require(output is not None and len(output) == len(profile["periods"]),
                                        "timephased_native_cardinality", "The native method returned another period count.", series["name"])
                                encoded, errors = [], []
                                for period, item in zip(profile["periods"], output):
                                    encoded.append(native._encode(item, errors, "timephased/" + row["key"] + "/" + series["name"] + "/" + period["key"]))
                                require(not errors, "timephased_native_value", "The native period output could not be retained completely.", errors)
                                value["values"] = encoded
                            except Exception as error:
                                value.update(state="native_error", values=None,
                                             error={"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)})
                                native_errors += 1
                        write(value)
                write({"record": "complete", "capture_id": capture_id, "assignments": assignment_count,
                       "series": assignment_count * len(profile["series"]), "facts": fact_count,
                       "native_errors": native_errors, "prior_records": lines})
                stream.flush()
                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            retained = operator_store.retain_file(temporary, content_hash.hexdigest(), written)
            require(retained["sha256"] == content_hash.hexdigest() and retained["bytes"] == written,
                    "timephased_retained_identity", "The original file store returned another calculation.")
            return {"schema": CAPTURE_SCHEMA, "capture_id": capture_id, "binding": binding,
                    "sha256": retained["sha256"], "bytes": retained["bytes"], "records": lines,
                    "header_sha256": digest(header), "assignment_count": assignment_count,
                    "fact_count": fact_count, "native_errors": native_errors}
    finally:
        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)

# Work, cost and material by period

The Portfolio archive can include native assignment values for explicit reporting periods. The existing PortfolioWorkspace reopens each selected immutable edition through its original MPXJ recipe. MPXJ calculates the values using that edition's native calendars, assignment rules and resource rates. The archive retains the complete calculation alongside its original project files and reporting tables.

Use this workflow for a completed-project reporting handover, a period-by-period cost/work review or a customer reporting dataset. Keep the selected editions, dates and financial interpretation in the published review. The ordinary project, task, resource and assignment tables remain available with their complete native fields.

## Select the source and periods

Open the original migration desk and choose **Portfolio archive**. Create or open the intended cohort. Select one actual immutable edition for each project, with a stable project key. Read the original field definitions after changing that selection.

Enable **Include native period reporting**. The panel accepts either generated daily, weekly or monthly date periods or individually entered local date/time periods. The date generator fills the explicit period list; it does not change a project calendar or calculate a value. Review that list before saving. A monthly series keeps the original day-of-month anchor and uses the month's last date when that day is absent.

Every period has a unique key, readable label and exact native start/finish bounds. Ranges use the project's original local date/time and must be ordered, nonempty and nonoverlapping in duration. The native boundary rule depends on the operation: duration overlap excludes the finish; instantaneous cost accrual can include both endpoints and selects the first matching range. At adjoining boundaries that can place a cost in the earlier period. These original native results are retained without redistribution. No timezone conversion or assumption that a working day is eight hours is made.

For an actual pro-rata COST resource with nonzero actual cost, MPXJ's selected original method derives a fixed whole-minute stride from the first range. This workflow therefore requires equal-width contiguous ranges with a positive whole-minute stride for the affected COST, ACTUAL_COST and ACTUAL_REGULAR_COST series. Unequal calendar months, gaps and sub-minute intervals are rejected before entering that native method. Select a fixed daily/weekly grid or change the reviewed series selection. The admission also bounds that method's internal alignment/full-assignment walk to 100,000 steps per assignment and two million estimated steps for the selected calculation. Its exact admitted basis is retained. Other supported native paths keep their original range semantics.

For example:

    {
      "key": "2026-10",
      "label": "October 2026",
      "start": "2026-10-01T00:00:00",
      "finish": "2026-11-01T00:00:00"
    }

The native calculation uses these exact boundaries. The original source must contain the intended project schedule and resource/calendar basis for that period. A valid empty period can produce native null values; the application retains that result.

A profile accepts 1–3,660 periods and 1–32 named series. The complete selected cohort is limited to 2,000,000 assignment × period × series facts. A larger reporting request should use a deliberately narrower period/series selection or separate reporting cohorts, each with its own source and review.

## Choose native series

Each series has a unique report name, an actual AssignmentField name, a kind and, for work, an explicit native unit. The selector uses the original field catalogue from the chosen editions. It rejects a kind that conflicts with any selected edition's native definition.

| Kind | Native definition | Calculation and grouping |
| --- | --- | --- |
| work | WORK | Original ResourceAssignment.getTimephasedDurationValues, with selected TimeUnit; unit and elapsed status remain separate. |
| money | CURRENCY | Original ResourceAssignment.getTimephasedNumericValues; native or explicitly reviewed project currency remains part of the group. |
| material | NUMERIC or UNITS | Original numeric period method for an actual material resource; each resource identity and material label remains separate. |

Supported selections include current, actual, remaining, planned and budget work/cost fields where present, regular/overtime variants, and baseline 0–10 work/cost/material and baseline-budget work/cost fields. Material selections include the native MATERIAL, ACTUAL_MATERIAL, REMAINING_MATERIAL and PLANNED_MATERIAL families where present. A name appearing in the source catalogue is still checked against the supported period-method field set.

Work units are MINUTES, HOURS, DAYS, WEEKS, MONTHS and YEARS, plus their ELAPSED_ forms. MPXJ performs the actual requested conversion against the native project settings. Material and money do not take a work-unit setting.

          "finish": "2026-11-01T00:00:00"

        {"name": "current_work", "field": "WORK", "kind": "work", "units": "HOURS"},

Save it as the cohort profile's **timephased** property. Existing columns, scalar metrics and currency declarations keep their original meaning. See examples/timephased-profile.json and examples/timephased-cohort.json for complete editable inputs.

## Review and publish

Save the cohort through its existing saved-action workflow. Review the exact saved revision. A first native period review requires the selected original MPXJ 16.10.0 runtime and the complete source objects already retained by the PortfolioWorkspace.

The native-project context holds the original runtime lock and reconstructs the original source recipe. It checks the actual assignment/task/resource identities against the retained model. Before a calculation, the original raw timephased source, resource detail/rate basis, field definitions and runtime identity must match that edition. The complete assignment effective calendar is retained even when MPXJ derives a calendar that has no standalone source calendar row. Baseline series use the actual ProjectFile.getBaselineCalendar value, including its native named-calendar/default fallback; that complete definition and source resolution are separately retained. Each series and fact identifies its calendar basis.

Each selected source gets an immutable, bounded JSONL calculation object. Its header binds the edition, model, source objects, recipe, complete period profile and runtime. Ordered assignment/series records retain every native value or null. The final footer records completion and counts. The original operator store publishes the complete object by its content address.

A completed calculation is reused by the original action. If an action loses its reply, reopen its saved request and continue that request. A complete stored calculation never requires a replacement native calculation. An interrupted calculation that has no accepted complete object can be regenerated from the same original edition and profile. No remote target write or project scheduling change is involved.

The review shows the complete assignment/fact counts, capture identities, native errors, table hashes and a bounded preview of period totals. **Open complete period totals**, **Open original assignment values** and **Open calendars and rate basis** page through the original publication tables. Publish the exact review with the reviewer and a concrete delivery decision. An edited selection, period, series or currency declaration requires a following review. Existing lost-reply, same-request and revision guards remain in effect.

## Interpret the values

The native period facts use **assignment grain**. They link to the actual source task and resource. Task-only fixed costs remain in their task fields and are outside these assignment totals. A scalar task/project measure can be reported separately, with its own grain; do not add it to the assignment total as another contribution to the same sum.

Each fact records one state:

| State | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| native_value | The original method returned a supported numeric or duration value, retained as exact text with its typed native value. |
| native_null | The original method returned null for that assignment, series and period. |
| not_applicable | The selected dimension does not apply to this actual resource type, such as work for a material resource. |
| native_error | The original method raised an error, retained with its original message and series identity. |
| unsupported_native_value | A returned value cannot be interpreted as the selected supported dimension; its full original representation remains retained. |

Native null is distinct from zero. An all-null total has no invented zero total. Totals include value, null, inapplicable and error counts so the reader can assess completeness. Native errors and unsupported values are visible in the review and retained facts.

Totals use exact decimal addition of original numeric text. Work groups preserve selected units and elapsed true/false. Money groups preserve project currency and its original or explicitly declared source. Unknown currencies remain project-local groups. Material groups retain the actual resource identity as well as its label; two resources with the same displayed unit are not automatically combined.

The raw source spans can use a duration representation for material quantities. Their explicit dimension, resource type, full typed values and separate native material-period calculation preserve that distinction. Raw amount-per-hour and span totals are source evidence, not a second set of period contributions to add to the calculated values.

The original relational tables remain complete. A timephased profile adds these tables:

Facts join their assignment, basis, period and series by retained IDs. Assignment basis links to actual task/resource entity IDs, with explicit resolution status. Assignment effective and project baseline calendars retain complete native JSON and a source calendar entity when uniquely resolved. Each native series/fact names the applicable basis. Derived native calendars remain usable as complete definitions without a guessed source join.

Their columns remain TEXT in CSV, SQLite and the generated Azure SQL schema so large IDs, precision, ISO local dates, native units and JSON survive the handover. def _value(row, field):
    value = row.get("fields", {}).get(field)
    return value.get("value") if isinstance(value, dict) else None


def _common(member, edition):
    return {"project_key": member["project_key"], "edition_id": edition["id"]}


def _entity(edition, family, row):
    return None if row is None else row_identity(edition["id"], family, row["key"])


def _by_uid(rows):
    result = defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:
        result[row.get("uid")].append(row)
    return result


def _unique(index, uid):
    matches = index.get(uid, [])
    return matches[0] if uid is not None and len(matches) == 1 else None


def source_rows(member, edition, emit):

    common, model = _common(member, edition), edition["model"]
    currency, currency_source = currency_context(member, model)
    resources = _by_uid(model["resources"])
    catalogue = model["field_catalogue"].get("assignments", {})
    for ordinal, row in enumerate(model["assignments"]):
        aid = _entity(edition, "assignments", row)
        resource = _unique(resources, row.get("resource_uid"))
        resource_type = None if resource is None else _value(resource, "TYPE")
        material_label = None if resource is None else _value(resource, "MATERIAL_LABEL")
        for field in sorted(name for name in catalogue if name.startswith("RAW_TIMEPHASED_")):
            pointer = "/assignments/" + str(ordinal) + "/fields/" + pointer_token(field)
            original = row["fields"].get(field)
            entries = original.get("value") if isinstance(original, dict) and original.get("type") == "list" else None
            state = ("not_present_in_fields" if field not in row["fields"] else
                     "null" if original is None else "list" if isinstance(entries, list) else "unsupported_structure")
            definition = catalogue[field]
            dimension = ("money" if field.endswith("_COST") else "material_stored_as_duration" if resource_type == "MATERIAL"
                         else "work" if resource_type == "WORK" else "native_storage")
            source_set_id = digest({"edition": edition["id"], "assignment": row["key"], "field": field, "capture": "fields"})
            emit("timephased_source_sets", {"source_set_id": source_set_id, **common,
                 "assignment_entity_id": aid, "source_key": row["key"], "field": field,
                 "native_data_type": definition.get("data_type"), "definition_sha256": digest(definition),
                 "capture": "fields", "state": state, "span_count": len(entries) if isinstance(entries, list) else None,

                 "resource_type": resource_type, "dimension": dimension})
            for index, entry in enumerate(entries if isinstance(entries, list) else []):
                body = entry.get("value", {}) if isinstance(entry, dict) and entry.get("type") == "map" else {}
                start, finish = typed_parts(body.get("start")), typed_parts(body.get("finish"))

        rid = _entity(edition, "resources", row)

        for table_index, entries in sorted(details.get("cost_rate_tables", {}).items(), key=lambda item: int(item[0])):

                cost = typed_parts(entry.get("cost_per_use"))
                emit("resource_rate_entries", {"rate_entry_id": identity, **common, "resource_entity_id": rid,
                     "source_key": row["key"], "table_index": table_index, "entry_ordinal": index,

        for index, entry in enumerate(details.get("availability", [])):
            emit("resource_availability", {"availability_id": digest({"edition": edition["id"], "resource": row["key"], "availability": index}),

            write("exception", index, value, prefix + "/exceptions/" + str(index), name=value.get("name"),

        for index, name in enumerate(("minutes_per_day", "minutes_per_week", "minutes_per_month", "minutes_per_year")):

    require(isinstance(descriptor, dict) and descriptor.get("schema") == CAPTURE_SCHEMA
            and descriptor.get("binding") == source_binding(edition, profile),
            "timephased_capture_binding", "Choose the retained native calculation for this exact source and period profile.")
    sha = checked_id(descriptor.get("sha256"))
    require(type(descriptor.get("bytes")) is int and 0 < descriptor["bytes"] <= MAX_CAPTURE_BYTES,
            "timephased_capture_size", "Retain the complete original calculation descriptor.")
    path = operator_store.root / "objects" / sha
    with open_regular(path) as stream:
        before = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        measured, byte_count, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0, 0

        def read():
            nonlocal byte_count, count
            line = stream.readline(MAX_LINE_BYTES + 1)
            require(line and len(line) <= MAX_LINE_BYTES and line.endswith(b"\n"),
                    "timephased_capture_record", "The native calculation contains a missing or incomplete record.")
            measured.update(line)
            byte_count += len(line)
            count += 1
            require(byte_count <= descriptor["bytes"], "timephased_capture_bytes", "The original calculation grew after capture.")
            value = json.loads(line.decode("utf-8"))
            require(isinstance(value, dict), "timephased_capture_record", "Retain the complete native record object.")
            return value

        header = read()
        require(digest(header) == descriptor.get("header_sha256") and header.get("record") == "header"
                and header.get("schema") == CAPTURE_SCHEMA and header.get("binding") == descriptor["binding"]
                and header.get("profile") == profile and header.get("capture_id") == descriptor.get("capture_id")
                and header.get("capture_id") == digest({"schema": CAPTURE_SCHEMA, "binding": header["binding"], "native": header["native"]})
                and header.get("native", {}).get("version") == edition["model"]["native"]["version"]
                and header.get("native", {}).get("upstream_commit") == edition["model"]["native"]["upstream_commit"],
                "timephased_capture_header", "The retained native calculation header changed.")
        assignment_count, period_count, series_count = len(edition["model"]["assignments"]), len(profile["periods"]), len(profile["series"])
        require(header["assignment_count"] == descriptor.get("assignment_count") == assignment_count
                and header["fact_count"] == descriptor.get("fact_count") == assignment_count * period_count * series_count,
                "timephased_capture_cardinality", "The saved calculation names another complete source selection.")
        definitions = edition["model"]["field_catalogue"].get("assignments", {})
        require(header["field_definitions"] == {item["field"]: definitions.get(item["field"]) for item in profile["series"]},
                "timephased_capture_definition", "The native calculation's selected field definitions changed.")
        require(header.get("series_semantics") == {item["name"]: series_semantics(item) for item in profile["series"]}
                and isinstance(header.get("baseline_calendar"), dict)
                and header.get("input_admission", {}).get("schema") == "portfolio.native-period-admission.v1",
                "timephased_capture_basis", "The original native calendar/range basis is incomplete or changed.")
        yield "header", header
        errors = 0
        for ordinal, row in enumerate(edition["model"]["assignments"]):
            basis = read()
            require(basis.get("record") == "assignment_basis" and basis.get("ordinal") == ordinal
                    and basis.get("assignment_key") == row["key"] and basis.get("assignment_uid") == row["uid"],
                    "timephased_capture_assignment", "The calculation belongs to another original assignment.")
            yield "basis", basis
            for selected in profile["series"]:
                record = read()
                require(record.get("record") == "series" and record.get("assignment_key") == row["key"]
                        and record.get("series") == selected["name"]
                        and record.get("state") in {"native", "not_applicable", "native_error"},
                        "timephased_capture_series", "The original assignment series is missing or out of order.")
                if record["state"] == "native":
                    require(isinstance(record.get("values"), list) and len(record["values"]) == period_count and record.get("error") is None,
                            "timephased_capture_values", "Retain one native value or null for every selected period.")
                else:
                    require(record.get("values") is None, "timephased_capture_values", "A non-value native result contains fabricated period values.")
                    if record["state"] == "native_error":
                        require(isinstance(record.get("error"), dict), "timephased_capture_error", "Retain the actual native calculation error.")
                        errors += 1
                    else:
                        require(record.get("error") is None and not applicable(selected["kind"], basis.get("resource_type")),
                                "timephased_capture_applicability", "The retained native series applicability changed.")
                yield "series", record
        trailer = read()
        require(trailer == {"record": "complete", "capture_id": header["capture_id"], "assignments": assignment_count,
                            "series": assignment_count * series_count, "facts": assignment_count * period_count * series_count,
                            "native_errors": errors, "prior_records": count - 1}
                and descriptor.get("native_errors") == errors and descriptor.get("records") == count and not stream.read(1),
                "timephased_capture_complete", "The complete native calculation footer or file closure changed.")
        after = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        require(byte_count == descriptor["bytes"] and measured.hexdigest() == sha
                and (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns, before.st_ctime_ns) ==
                    (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns, after.st_ctime_ns),
                "timephased_capture_hash", "The original calculation bytes changed during receiving.")


class _Totals:
    """Bounded-memory scratch aggregation; final decimal text remains exact."""
    def __init__(self, directory):
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="timephased-totals-", dir=directory)
        self.connection = sqlite3.connect(str(Path(self.temporary.name) / "totals.sqlite"))
        self.connection.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=OFF")
        self.connection.execute("PRAGMA cache_size=-8192")
        self.connection.execute("CREATE TABLE totals (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, meta TEXT NOT NULL, total TEXT, values_n INTEGER, nulls_n INTEGER, na_n INTEGER, errors_n INTEGER)")

    def add(self, meta, state, number=None):
        identity = digest(meta)
        row = self.connection.execute("SELECT total, values_n, nulls_n, na_n, errors_n FROM totals WHERE id=?", (identity,)).fetchone()
        total, values, nulls, na, errors = row if row else (None, 0, 0, 0, 0)
        if state == "native_value":
            total = str(number) if total is None else exact_sum([decimal_value(total), number])
            values += 1
        elif state == "native_null":
            nulls += 1
        elif state == "not_applicable":
            na += 1
        else:
            errors += 1
        self.connection.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO totals VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                                (identity, encoded(meta), total, values, nulls, na, errors))

    def rows(self):
        for identity, meta, total, values, nulls, na, errors in self.connection.execute("SELECT * FROM totals ORDER BY id"):
            yield {"total_id": identity, **json.loads(meta), "total_text": total, "value_rows": values,
                   "null_rows": nulls, "not_applicable_rows": na, "error_rows": errors,
                   "completeness": "native_errors" if errors else "native_values_and_nulls" if values
                                   else "all_native_null" if nulls else "not_applicable"}

    def close(self):
        self.connection.close()
        self.temporary.cleanup()


def project_rows(member, edition, profile, descriptor, operator_store, emit, directory, *, stopped=None):
    """Emit one source-bound projection from a complete native capture."""
    source_rows(member, edition, emit)
    common, model = _common(member, edition), edition["model"]
    currency, currency_source = currency_context(member, model)
    selected_sha = profile_sha(profile)
    by_key = {family: {row["key"]: row for row in model[family]}
              for family in ("assignments", "resources", "tasks", "calendars")}
    definitions = model["field_catalogue"].get("assignments", {})
    series_by_name = {item["name"]: item for item in profile["series"]}
    for ordinal, period in enumerate(profile["periods"]):
        emit("timephased_periods", {"period_id": period_identity(edition["id"], profile, period["key"]),
             **common, "profile_sha256": selected_sha, "period_key": period["key"],
             "label": period["label"], "ordinal": ordinal, "start_text": period["start"],
             "finish_text": period["finish"], "range_semantics": RANGE_SEMANTICS})
    for series in profile["series"]:
        definition = definitions.get(series["field"])
        emit("timephased_series", {"series_id": series_identity(edition["id"], profile, series["name"]),
             **common, "profile_sha256": selected_sha, "series": series["name"], "field": series["field"],
             "kind": series["kind"], "requested_units": series.get("units"),
             "native_data_type": None if definition is None else definition.get("data_type"),
             "definition_sha256": digest(definition), "definition_json": encoded(definition),
             "method": method(series), "grain": "original_resource_assignments", **series_semantics(series),
             "source_pointer": "/field_catalogue/assignments/" + pointer_token(series["field"])})
    totals = _Totals(directory)
    capture_id, basis, row, resource, line_number = None, None, None, None, 0
    baseline_value = None
    finding_groups, preview, total_count = {}, [], 0

    def finding(code, series, pointer, error):
        key = (code, series)
        group = finding_groups.setdefault(key, {"code": code, "series": series, "occurrences": 0, "examples": []})
        group["occurrences"] += 1
        if len(group["examples"]) < 10:
            group["examples"].append({"source_pointer": pointer, "error": error})

    try:
        for record_kind, value in capture_records(operator_store, descriptor, edition, profile):
            require(stopped is None or not stopped(), "timephased_interrupted",
                    "Reopen this original reporting projection to continue its retained calculation.")
            line_number += 1
            locator = "source/operator-objects/" + descriptor["sha256"] + "#line=" + str(line_number)
            if record_kind == "header":
                capture_id = value["capture_id"]
                baseline = value["baseline_calendar"]
                baseline_value = baseline.get("value")
                baseline_row = by_key["calendars"].get(baseline.get("key"))
                require(baseline.get("resolution") in {"not_set", "native_object", "derived_native_object"}
                        and ((baseline.get("key") is None and baseline_row is None)
                             or baseline_row is not None and isinstance(baseline_value, dict)
                             and baseline_row["uid"] == baseline_value.get("uid"))
                        and (baseline_row is not None) == (baseline.get("resolution") == "native_object")
                        and (baseline_value is not None) == (baseline.get("resolution") != "not_set"),
                        "timephased_baseline_calendar", "The native baseline calendar points to another original source.")
                for error in baseline.get("findings", []):
                    finding("timephased_native_baseline_finding", "", locator, error)
                emit("timephased_captures", {"capture_id": capture_id, **common,
                     "model_sha256": edition["sha256"], "profile_sha256": selected_sha,
                     "recipe_sha256": value["binding"]["recipe_sha256"], "native_version": value["native"]["version"],
                     "native_runtime_json": encoded(value["native"]), "captured_at": value["captured_at"],
                     "assignment_count": value["assignment_count"], "fact_count": value["fact_count"],
                     "sha256": descriptor["sha256"], "bytes": descriptor["bytes"],
                     "package_path": "source/operator-objects/" + descriptor["sha256"],
                     "baseline_calendar_uid": None if baseline_value is None else baseline_value.get("uid"),
                     "baseline_calendar_entity_id": _entity(edition, "calendars", baseline_row),
                     "baseline_calendar_resolution": baseline["resolution"],
                     "baseline_calendar_sha256": digest(baseline_value),
                     "baseline_calendar_json": encoded(baseline_value),
                     "input_admission_json": encoded(value["input_admission"]),
                     "binding_json": encoded(value["binding"])})
                continue
            if record_kind == "basis":
                basis, row = value, by_key["assignments"][value["assignment_key"]]
                resource = by_key["resources"].get(basis.get("resource_key"))
                task = by_key["tasks"].get(basis.get("task_key"))
                calendar = by_key["calendars"].get(basis.get("calendar_key"))
                require((basis.get("resource_key") is None or resource is not None and resource["uid"] == row.get("resource_uid"))
                        and (basis.get("task_key") is None or task is not None and task["uid"] == row.get("task_uid")),
                        "timephased_basis_links", "The native calculation refers to another original assignment relationship.")
                require(basis.get("resource_resolution") in {"not_set", "native_object"}
                        and basis.get("task_resolution") in {"not_set", "native_object"}
                        and (resource is not None) == (basis.get("resource_resolution") == "native_object")
                        and (task is not None) == (basis.get("task_resolution") == "native_object"),
                        "timephased_basis_resolution", "Retain the original native object's exact source-row resolution.")
                require(resource is None or basis.get("resource_rates_sha256") == digest(resource.get("native_details")),
                        "timephased_basis_rates", "The calculation's native rates differ from the retained original resource.")
                if resource is not None:
                    require(basis.get("resource_type") == _value(resource, "TYPE")
                            and basis.get("material_label") == _value(resource, "MATERIAL_LABEL"),
                            "timephased_basis_resource", "The source resource type or material unit changed.")
                effective = basis.get("effective_calendar")
                require(calendar is None if basis.get("calendar_key") is None else calendar is not None
                        and isinstance(effective, dict) and calendar["uid"] == effective.get("uid"),
                        "timephased_basis_calendar", "The selected effective calendar refers to another source.")
                basis_id = digest({"capture": capture_id, "assignment": row["key"]})
                emit("timephased_assignment_basis", {"basis_id": basis_id, "capture_id": capture_id, **common,
                     "assignment_entity_id": _entity(edition, "assignments", row), "source_key": row["key"],
                     "task_entity_id": _entity(edition, "tasks", task), "task_resolution": basis["task_resolution"],
                     "resource_entity_id": _entity(edition, "resources", resource), "resource_resolution": basis["resource_resolution"],
                     "resource_type": basis.get("resource_type"), "material_label": basis.get("material_label"),
                     "effective_calendar_uid": None if effective is None else effective.get("uid"),
                     "calendar_entity_id": _entity(edition, "calendars", calendar),
                     "calendar_resolution": basis.get("calendar_resolution"), "calendar_sha256": digest(effective),
                     "effective_calendar_json": encoded(effective), "cost_rate_table_json": encoded(basis.get("cost_rate_table")),
                     "resource_rates_sha256": basis.get("resource_rates_sha256"),
                     "native_range_admission_json": encoded(basis.get("native_range_admission")), "source_pointer": locator})
                for error in basis.get("findings", []):
                    finding("timephased_native_basis_finding", "", locator, error)
                continue
            series = series_by_name[value["series"]]
            definition = definitions.get(series["field"])
            sid = series_identity(edition["id"], profile, series["name"])
            aid, rid = _entity(edition, "assignments", row), _entity(edition, "resources", resource)
            bid = digest({"capture": capture_id, "assignment": row["key"]})
            if value["state"] == "native_error":
                finding("timephased_native_calculation_error", series["name"], locator, value["error"])
            for index, period in enumerate(profile["periods"]):
                pid = period_identity(edition["id"], profile, period["key"])
                original = value["values"][index] if value["state"] == "native" else None
                parts = typed_parts(original)
                state = "native_null" if value["state"] == "native" and original is None else "native_value" if value["state"] == "native" else value["state"]
                error, number = value.get("error"), None
                if state == "native_value":
                    try:
                        if series["kind"] == "work":
                            valid_type = (parts["type"] == "duration" and parts["units"] == series["units"]
                                          and type(original.get("elapsed")) is bool
                                          and original["elapsed"] == series["units"].startswith("ELAPSED_"))
                        else:
                            valid_type = parts["type"] in {"integer", "number"}
                        require(valid_type, "timephased_native_value_type",
                                "Retain the selected native value type and exact requested unit.")
                        number = decimal_value(parts["text"])
                    except Exception as invalid:
                        state = "unsupported_native_value"
                        error = {"type": type(invalid).__name__, "message": str(invalid), "original": original}
                        finding("timephased_native_value_error", series["name"], locator + "&period=" + period["key"], error)
                selected_currency = currency if series["kind"] == "money" else None
                selected_currency_source = currency_source if series["kind"] == "money" else None
                units = series.get("units") if series["kind"] == "work" else basis.get("material_label") if series["kind"] == "material" else None
                elapsed = ("true" if series["units"].startswith("ELAPSED_") else "false") if series["kind"] == "work" else None
                meta = {"capture_id": capture_id, **common, "series_id": sid, "series": series["name"],
                        "field": series["field"], "kind": series["kind"], "grain": "original_resource_assignments",
                        "period_id": pid, "period_key": period["key"], "start_text": period["start"], "finish_text": period["finish"],
                        "currency": selected_currency, "currency_source": selected_currency_source,
                        "units": units, "elapsed": elapsed,
                        "material_resource_entity_id": rid if series["kind"] == "material" and state != "not_applicable" else None,
                        "material_label": basis.get("material_label") if series["kind"] == "material" and state != "not_applicable" else None,
                        "native_data_type": None if definition is None else definition.get("data_type"),
                        "definition_sha256": digest(definition)}
                emit("timephased_values", {"fact_id": digest({"capture": capture_id, "assignment": row["key"],
                                                             "series": series["name"], "period": period["key"]}),
                     "capture_id": capture_id, "basis_id": bid, **common, "assignment_entity_id": aid,
                     "source_key": row["key"], "series_id": sid, "series": series["name"], "field": series["field"],
                     "kind": series["kind"], "calendar_basis": series_semantics(series)["calendar_basis"],
                     "calendar_sha256": digest(baseline_value if series["field"].startswith("BASELINE") else basis.get("effective_calendar")),
                     "period_id": pid, "period_key": period["key"],
                     "start_text": period["start"], "finish_text": period["finish"], "state": state,
                     "value_text": parts["text"], "value_type": parts["type"], "units": units, "elapsed": elapsed,
                     "currency": selected_currency, "currency_source": selected_currency_source,
                     "material_label": basis.get("material_label"), "resource_entity_id": rid,
                     "resource_type": basis.get("resource_type"),
                     "native_data_type": meta["native_data_type"], "definition_sha256": meta["definition_sha256"],
                     "value_json": encoded(original), "error_json": encoded(error),
                     "source_pointer": locator + "&period=" + period["key"]})
                totals.add(meta, state, number)
        for total in totals.rows():
            emit("timephased_totals", total)
            total_count += 1
            if len(preview) < 200:
                preview.append(total)
    finally:
        totals.close()
    findings = []
    for group in finding_groups.values():
        value = {"code": group["code"], "severity": "review",
                 "message": "The original native period calculation retained findings; inspect its exact source records and complete fact table.",
                 "details": group}
        findings.append({"id": digest(value), **value})
    return {"findings": findings, "totals_count": total_count, "totals_preview": preview,
            "capture": {"edition_id": edition["id"], "capture_id": descriptor["capture_id"],
                        "sha256": descriptor["sha256"], "bytes": descriptor["bytes"],
                        "assignment_count": descriptor["assignment_count"],
                        "fact_count": descriptor["fact_count"], "native_errors": descriptor["native_errors"]}}

"""Run the whole native source/round-trip/receiving flow on pinned MPXJ fixtures."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
from decimal import Decimal
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from portfolio import PortfolioWorkspace
from portfolio.storage import atomic_json, canonical, file_identity, read_json, require

UPSTREAM = "7ef9e72813d33378c55ec6ceb148cc831ed22033"
FIXTURES = [
    {"path": "junit/data/timephased-budget-baseline.mpp", "blob": "f4d2dcb2b74a829a6368d106a55e68712f417c68", "bytes": 354304},
    {"path": "junit/data/calendar-exception-precedence-daily.mpp", "blob": "77e7036f04f3cc582c61438c0deee30834d4d3b1", "bytes": 240640},
    {"path": "junit/data/generated/assignment-assignments/assignment-assignments-project2019-mspdi.xml", "blob": "229c381968ee1b23d2027a20eff0983dab3e855b", "bytes": 38478},
    {"path": "junit/data/baselines.xml", "blob": "f2b689d213abc719d55394f476c329634fc47517", "bytes": 24522},
    {"path": "junit/data/enterprise.xml", "blob": "11d5ddf8e3b799a655000890612e623ad9f935df", "bytes": 46339},
]


def run(upstream, directory):
    upstream, directory = Path(upstream).absolute(), Path(directory).absolute()
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
    result_path = directory / "result.json"
    if result_path.exists():
        result = read_json(result_path)
        require(file_identity(result["archive"]["path"]) == {k: result["archive"][k] for k in ("sha256", "bytes")},
                "receiving_archive_changed", "The completed receiving archive changed.")
        restored = PortfolioWorkspace(result["receiving"]["destination"])
        for row in result["sources"]:
            require(restored.read_edition(row["edition_id"])["sha256"] == row["model_sha256"],
                    "receiving_edition_changed", "A received original native model changed.")
        return result
    ws = PortfolioWorkspace(directory / "workspace")
    runtime = ws.native.ensure()
    atomic_json(directory / "native-runtime.json", runtime, immutable=True)
    selected, captures = [], []
    for fixture in FIXTURES:
        path = upstream / fixture["path"]
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        blob = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(raw)).encode("ascii") + b"\0" + raw).hexdigest()
        require(len(raw) == fixture["bytes"] and blob == fixture["blob"],
                "upstream_fixture_changed", "Use the unchanged fixture from the pinned maintained engine.", fixture)
        original = {"path": fixture["path"], "upstream_commit": UPSTREAM, "git_blob": blob, **file_identity(path)}
        selected.append(original)
        request = "native-intake-" + blob
        edition = ws.intake(request, path, label=Path(fixture["path"]).name)
        # Reopen the exact completed original request; this must not create another edition.
        reopened = ws.intake(request, path, label=Path(fixture["path"]).name)
        require(reopened["id"] == edition["id"], "intake_replay", "A repeated original intake must reopen its recorded edition.")
        export = ws.export_mspdi("native-export-" + blob, edition["id"])
        repeated = ws.export_mspdi("native-export-" + blob, edition["id"])
        require(repeated["id"] == export["id"] and repeated["sha256"] == export["sha256"],
                "export_replay", "A repeated native export must reopen the original bytes.")
        comparison = ws.store.record("comparisons", export["comparison_id"])
        captures.append({"fixture": original, "edition_id": edition["id"], "model_sha256": edition["sha256"],
                         "counts": edition["model"]["counts"], "findings": edition["findings"],
                         "native_export": export, "comparison": comparison})
    atomic_json(directory / "original-fixtures.json", selected, immutable=True)
    original = ws.read_edition(captures[2]["edition_id"])
    target = next(row for row in original["model"]["tasks"]
                  if row["uid"] not in (None, "0") and row["fields"].get("NAME", {}).get("type") == "string")
    correction = {"family": "tasks", "key": target["key"], "field": "NAME",
                  "before": target["fields"]["NAME"],
                  "after": {"type": "string", "value": target["fields"]["NAME"]["value"] + " — native receiving correction"}}
    corrections = [correction]
    fixed_cost = target["fields"].get("FIXED_COST")
    if fixed_cost and fixed_cost["type"] in {"number", "integer"}:
        corrections.append({"family": "tasks", "key": target["key"], "field": "FIXED_COST",
                            "before": fixed_cost, "after": {"type": "number",
                            "value": str(Decimal(fixed_cost["value"]) + Decimal("17.125"))}})
    review = ws.review(original["id"], target_profile={"kind": "mspdi"}, corrections=corrections)
    require(review["ready"], "native_review", "The selected original file correction must be ready.", review["unresolved"])
    changed = ws.apply_review("native-reviewed-correction", review["id"])
    corrected_output = ws.export_mspdi("native-corrected-output", changed["edition_id"])
    returned = ws.read_edition(corrected_output["native_readback_edition_id"])
    changed_row = next(row for row in returned["model"]["tasks"] if row["uid"] == target["uid"])
    require(changed_row["fields"]["NAME"]["value"] == correction["after"]["value"],
            "native_name_roundtrip", "The original native correction must survive actual MSPDI readback.")
    # A full archive is an original source/model/history delivery, including
    # features which the native file format itself cannot carry.
    archive = ws.export_workspace(directory / "portfolio-workspace.zip")
    received = PortfolioWorkspace.receive_workspace(archive["path"], directory / "received")
    restored = PortfolioWorkspace(received["destination"])
    require(restored.read_edition(changed["edition_id"])["sha256"] == changed["edition"]["sha256"],
            "native_receiving_model", "The received corrected native model must retain its complete original identity.")
    restored_export = restored.export_mspdi("native-corrected-output", changed["edition_id"])
    require(restored_export["sha256"] == corrected_output["sha256"]
            and Path(restored_export["path"]).is_relative_to(restored.root),
            "native_receiving_export", "The original export must reopen from the received workspace.")
    result = {"schema": "project-portfolio-native-receiving.v1", "state": "complete", "runtime": runtime,
              "sources": captures, "review_id": review["id"], "corrected_edition_id": changed["edition_id"],
              "corrections": corrections, "corrected_export": corrected_output,
              "archive": archive, "receiving": received,
              "source_workspace": str(ws.root), "restored_export_path": restored_export["path"]}
    atomic_json(result_path, result, immutable=True)
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--upstream", required=True, help="Pinned original MPXJ checkout or unchanged fixture root")
    parser.add_argument("--directory", required=True, help="Original receiving operation directory; reuse to reopen")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = run(args.upstream, args.directory)
    print(json.dumps({"state": result["state"], "result": str(Path(args.directory).absolute() / "result.json"),
                      "source_workspace": result["source_workspace"], "receiving": result["receiving"]}, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
